acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Void Horrors family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Outer Sovereign, T5, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Unresolved-Ring Sovereign (Sovereign) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.

anatomyInvariants: Silhouette-shaped absence ringed with unblinking eyes and geometry that remains deliberately unresolved.

Signature mechanic: Arena Phase — Unfinishable Witness: one eye-ring interval opens, the world-shaped absence subtracts a quadrant, and a lower Void Horror performs its learned rule along the last resolvable boundary.
battlefieldDuty: Phase an arena around an unresolved sovereign absence whose eye ring restages each learned subtraction rule.
constructionDimensions: Family-native, non-affinity negative space, void black, star flecks, cold eye accent, fractured geometry, and non-reflection remain source-supported absence, interior, accent, deformation, and optical behavior—not Fire, Earth, Wind, Water, or any other affinity.
Open edges, missing spans, shifting proportions, eye rings, and geometric shards preserve absence instead of filling it with ordinary matter.
counterplay: Answer the called lower-form subtraction and strike the open eye-ring interval; each closed group restores a boundary and removes one phase route. Affinity signal: The established limb pause, face-hole rim, eye orbit gap, partial edge, or sovereign eye-ring break remains readable.
forbiddenTreatments: Resolving absence into ordinary material for spectacle
identityInvariants: Rough humanoid or many-limbed absence retains edges that fail to close while proportions shift only within readable tier silhouettes.
Matte void black, negative space, purple-black, star flecks, and one bounded cold eye accent remain source grammar rather than affinity evidence.
Absence, non-reflection, star-field interior, fractured geometry, eye rings, and geometric shards never resolve into ordinary flesh or matter.
Power subtracts coherence: later forms occupy less resolvable physical presence while telegraph anchors become deliberately sparse.
telegraph: A group of unblinking eyes closes in sequence while geometry refuses to resolve around the remaining open interval.
